detailed_description: The Theme River Generator builds flowing stream-style charts that emphasize how category volume changes over time around a central baseline. It is useful when you want a more narrative visual for topics, channels, or trends that rise and fall across the same period. You can enter grouped time-based data, adjust colors, labels, legend settings, and layout options, then export the finished chart as PNG or SVG after reviewing the live preview.
usage_steps: Enter time-based labels and grouped values for each stream in the chart editor.
Set the chart title and confirm the categories are arranged in a readable order.
Adjust colors, legend visibility, and spacing until the flowing layers are easy to distinguish.
Review the preview and refine labels or values where streams overlap too tightly.
Export the completed theme river chart as PNG or SVG for a report, article, or presentation.
usage_examples: Show how discussion volume around several product themes changes across a launch period.
Visualize media mentions by topic over time for a communications review.
Present shifts in traffic share across acquisition channels in a more narrative visual style.
